title: Pilchard and tomato pasta
steps: Cook the spaghetti in salted boiling water as the pack says (usually 10 to 12 minutes).
Meanwhile chop the onion and crush a clove of garlic, and fry them in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the chopped tomatoes and the pilchards with their sauce, break the fish into pieces and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until it wilts, then drain the spaghetti and toss it through the sauce. Season with pepper and a squeeze of lemon.
